props.name: currency
props.comment: ISO-4217 currency code when storage is a plain number.

props.name: currencies
props.comment: Provide to enable currency selection; stores composite { amount, currency }.

props.name: displayLocale
props.comment: Override the app locale for formatting the symbol/step.

props.name: storeAsMinorUnits
props.comment: Multiply displayed major units by 100 on write so storage is integer cents.

props.name: source
props.comment: The field path (dot/bracket), relative to the ambient source scope.

props.name: label
props.comment: Explicit label, or `false` to hide it. Absent → humanized `source`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: Input-level default (seeds only into a hole), typed as the value at `source`.

props.name: validate
props.comment: ra-contract validators — composed, first error wins.
